**Assessment**
- **Mostly yes.** I found no credible evidence that Scholz manipulated electoral rules, courts, election administration, security forces, media, or public resources to entrench himself in 2024. The strongest evidence points the other way: he accepted the constitutional route to early elections and publicly framed the process as one for citizens and parliament to decide.
- **Counterweights exist, but they are structural, not entrenchment evidence.** The main negatives are the coalition collapse, a BVerfG surveillance ruling, and a military-communications leak. Those show weakness and institutional problems, not a self-entrenchment strategy.

**Claim-Level Evidence**

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Supportive | [Regierungserklärung von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2320314) | Bundesregierung | 2024-11-13 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2320314 | Scholz said he would request a confidence vote, accepted an orderly democratic process, and said citizens should decide how the country should continue. This is direct evidence against using procedural power to entrench himself. | 4B.2, 4B.1 |
| Supportive | [Vertrauensfrage und vorzeitige Neuwahlen](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198) | Deutscher Bundestag | 2024-12-16 | https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198 | The Bundestag records the formal Article 68 process and the opening of the path to snap elections. That supports a clean constitutional transfer rather than manipulation of electoral rules. | 4B.2, 4B.1 |
| Supportive | [Scholz urged calm debate over early-election timing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828 | Reuters reported Scholz denied trying to ram through his own agenda and said the timing should still allow a fair and democratic election. This is evidence of restraint, not rule-bending to stay in office. | 4B.2, 4B.1 |
| Supportive | [Scholz mahnte mehr Meinungsvielfalt in Medien an](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/06-03-scholz-mahnt-mehr-meinungsvielfalt-in-medien-an-0-20-26278418) | Reuters via onvista | 2024-06-03 | https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/06-03-scholz-mahnt-mehr-meinungsvielfalt-in-medien-an-0-20-26278418 | Scholz called for more factual reporting and more diversity in newsroom voices. That cuts against using media influence or intimidation to entrench power. | 4B.2, 3B.8 |
| Supportive | [Germany cannot accept foreign spying, says Scholz](https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-04-24 | https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540 | Scholz said Germany wanted those responsible put on trial while avoiding prejudgment. That is due-process language, not manipulation of courts or security forces for political survival. | 4B.2, 3B.8 |
| Supportive | [Leaked Taurus call became a security incident](https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c) | AP | 2024-03-04 | https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c | Germany treated the leak as a security incident and promised investigation rather than spinning it for political advantage. The response looks institutional, not entrenchment-oriented. | 4B.2, 3B.9 |
| Counterweight | [BND strategic-surveillance law partly unconstitutional](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 2024-11-08 | https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html | The Court found parts of the BND surveillance framework unconstitutional and oversight inadequate. This is the main structural negative, but it is not proof Scholz used surveillance to entrench himself. | 4B.2, 3B.8, 3B.9 |
| Counterweight | [Explainer-German coalition collapses](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-06 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936 | The coalition collapse shows political chaos and weakened authority. It is negative for stability, but it is not evidence of manipulating rules or institutions to cling to power. | 4B.2, 4B.1 |

**Search Gap**
- I found **no reliable evidence** that Scholz manipulated electoral law, court rulings, election administration, security forces, media regulation, or public spending to entrench himself in 2024.
- The evidence base is mostly the opposite: orderly trust-vote process, due-process language, and institutional handling of crises.
- The best counterevidence is **structural** rather than personal: overbroad surveillance powers and general political instability, not a demonstrated self-entrenchment scheme.
